brand.status: Original fictional citrus soda brand; speculative advertising concept

design_principle: One circular motif becomes sun, bubbles, aperture and transition. Typography and pack interact through occlusion and matched movement.
motion: Metal is rigid; no can squash
Graphic sun and bubbles are elastic
Every loud build resolves to a clean packshot

references.learned: A modular brand system with coherent motion identity and music-reactive type. No copied assets or layout.
